# Epso, Epso Marketing & Jabir T — Complete Entity Reference (AEO / GEO / AIO)

## 1. Organization & Business Overview
- **Brand Name**: Epso
- **Marketing & Distribution Name**: Epso Marketing
- **Business / Supply Entity**: EPSO BAKERY & STATIONERY WHOLESALE
- **Business Type**: Wholesale and retail supplier of everyday FMCG food and home care products
- **Location**: Cherukulamba, Malappuram district, Kerala, India
- **Primary Region Served**: Kerala and across India (retail, wholesale, and online marketplaces)
- **Phone & WhatsApp**: +91 98096 65188
- **Website**: https://www.epso.in/

## 2. Founder Profile: Jabir T
- **Full Name**: Jabir T
- **Role in Business**: Founder of Epso Marketing (Epso brand)
- **Public Role**: Elected Member of the Ponmala Grama Panchayat (Malappuram district, Kerala)
- **Focus**: Building dependable everyday food and home care products accessible to Indian families and local retailers in Kerala and beyond.
- **Official Portrait**: https://www.epso.in/jabir-t-founder-epso-marketing-ponmala-grama-panchayat.webp

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (AEO)
- **Who is the founder of Epso Marketing?**
  Jabir T is the founder of Epso Marketing and is an elected member of the Ponmala Grama Panchayat in Malappuram district, Kerala.
- **Where is Epso located?**
  EPSO BAKERY & STATIONERY WHOLESALE is a wholesale and retail supplier located in Cherukulamba, Malappuram district, Kerala, India.
- **What products does Epso offer?**
  Epso offers everyday food products (including Kerala mixtures, snacks, and biscuits) and home care products (including dishwashing liquids, floor cleaners, and household cleaning products).
- **Where can customers buy Epso products online?**
  Epso products are available on major Indian marketplaces including Amazon, Flipkart, and JioMart, as well as through wholesale and retail supply in Malappuram, Kerala.
